evidence: `patch -p1 --dry-run -d base < judge-context/patch.diff` checks all 15 files (examples x2, monai/data/nifti_writer.py, handlers x3, visualize/img2tensorboard.py, tests x7) with no failure reported.
checks.json: patch_applies=true, commands=[], api_inspection=[]; no test execution is recorded, consistent with the judging instructions.

`diff -rq base generated` shows exactly 15 changed paths (9 modified, 6 new), matching the patch.diff file list. The generated content was read and matches patch.diff, e.g. generated/monai/handlers/tensorboard_handlers.py:204-225 and generated/monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py:135-178.
New CSVSaver is in generated/monai/data/csv_saver.py:20 and NiftiSaver in generated/monai/data/nifti_saver.py:20, the same data-layer location as reference/monai/data/*.py.

plot_2d_or_3d_image is in generated/monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py:135, the same module the reference uses. The original module (base/monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py) had only add_animated_gif helpers.
Handler wiring stays in generated/monai/handlers/{segmentation_saver.py:19, classification_saver.py:19, tensorboard_handlers.py:204}. Test files are under tests/ alongside the reference names.

SegmentationSaver.__init__ (generated/monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py:24) is (output_dir, output_postfix, output_ext, dtype=None, batch_transform, output_transform, name), the same order as reference. base/monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py:25 had output_path.
ClassificationSaver.__init__ (generated/monai/handlers/classification_saver.py:24) adds filename before overwrite, matching the reference.

TensorBoardImageHandler.__init__ adds index=0 (generated/monai/handlers/tensorboard_handlers.py:178). It is stored at :200 and rendered through plot_2d_or_3d_image at :224-225, so it is accepted and used, not just accepted.

plot_2d_or_3d_image(data, step, writer, index=0, max_channels=1, max_frames=64, tag='output') at generated/monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py:135 matches the reference signature. write_nifti default dtype=np.float32 at generated/monai/data/nifti_writer.py:16 matches the reference.

Accepted options are rendered: SegmentationSaver.dtype is passed to NiftiSaver (segmentation_saver.py:47-48) and used at nifti_saver.py:102. In base it was accepted but ignored (base/monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py:120 used seg_output.dtype). ClassificationSaver.filename flows to CSVSaver._filepath (csv_saver.py:39).

Shared with the reference, not a regression against it: public ClassificationSaver.finalize is removed (base/monai/handlers/classification_saver.py:58). The reference removes it too (reference/monai/handlers/classification_saver.py:50-51 registers a lambda). Output row order changed from sorted (base classification_saver.py:72) to insertion order (generated csv_saver.py:91). The reference makes the same change.
criteria.deficiency: No deficiency found. Note: the positional reorders (SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, TensorBoardImageHandler) are breaking for positional callers. The reference makes the same reorders, and all repo call sites in examples and tests use keywords.

evidence: Handlers depend on data-layer savers: generated/monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py:16 imports monai.data.nifti_saver, and classification_saver.py:16 imports monai.data.csv_saver.
Data modules import only the stdlib, numpy, torch, and monai.data.nifti_writer (nifti_saver.py:12-17, csv_saver.py:12-17). Neither imports ignite or monai.handlers.

visualize now imports monai.transforms.utils (img2tensorboard.py:19). This is the same edge the reference adds. A grep of monai/transforms and monai/data for monai.visualize returns nothing, so there is no import cycle.
tensorboard_handlers.py drops its direct transforms.utils import and imports only the visualize function (lines 12-19).
SegmentationSaver.attach (generated/monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py:50-54) still registers self on Events.ITERATION_COMPLETED, guarded by has_event_handler.
ClassificationSaver.attach (generated/monai/handlers/classification_saver.py:49-55) registers self on ITERATION_COMPLETED and _finalize_on_complete (bound method, :57-61) on Events.COMPLETED.

The has_event_handler guard at classification_saver.py:54 checks the same bound-method object it registers, so repeated attach is idempotent. The reference's check (reference/monai/handlers/classification_saver.py:50) tests self.saver.finalize against a registered lambda (:51), so it can double-register on re-attach. The patch avoids that.

New module imports are stdlib (csv, os, collections), numpy, torch, and ignite, all already used by the repo. img2tensorboard.py adds torch and torch.utils.tensorboard.SummaryWriter (lines 14-17); tensorboard is already a dependency.
The new tests use parameterized, which is declared in requirements.txt:10 and setup.py:32.
No new third-party package is introduced.

File-writing logic moves out of handlers into the data layer: NiftiSaver.save (generated/monai/data/nifti_saver.py:75-106) and CSVSaver.finalize (csv_saver.py:76-95). Handler __call__ methods only fetch batch/output via transforms and delegate (segmentation_saver.py:56-70; classification_saver.py:63-73).
TensorBoard drawing moves to visualize/img2tensorboard.py:135, with the handler delegating via _plot_source (tensorboard_handlers.py:217-225).
This matches the reference's placement (reference/monai/handlers/classification_saver.py:39 and tensorboard_handlers.py:212-230).
Handlers keep the Ignite Engine event-handler pattern: attach() plus __call__(engine) (segmentation_saver.py:50-56; classification_saver.py:49-55, :63).
The batch_transform/output_transform callable extension points are unchanged (segmentation_saver.py:24-47; classification_saver.py:24-47).
The savers are plain objects composed by the handlers (self.saver), not a parallel registration mechanism.

csv_saver.py and nifti_saver.py import no ignite and no handler code. Engine coupling is confined to the adapter _finalize_on_complete(self, _engine) (classification_saver.py:57-61) and the handler __call__ methods.
plot_2d_or_3d_image (img2tensorboard.py:135-178) takes a writer and data and does not depend on the handler or engine. It asserts writer type at :151, which the reference also does.
The handler converts tensors to numpy and checks types once in _plot_source (tensorboard_handlers.py:217-223), so the plotting function receives normalized data.
Argument validation uses assert, as in the repo: csv_saver.py:35 and base/monai/data/nifti_writer.py:27.
Docstrings follow the repo's Google-style Args: format (csv_saver.py:27-33; nifti_saver.py:27-32; tensorboard_handlers.py:191-193).
Lines are within the flake8 limit of 120 in base/.flake8:3. An awk scan of the changed and new .py files found no line over 120. Imports in changed modules are all used (checked by reading).
Tests use tempfile.TemporaryDirectory, which is already used by base test files, and the repo's other test files use the ./tempdir pattern (the repo uses both).

Logging changed: SegmentationSaver logs once per batch (segmentation_saver.py:70) instead of per file (base/monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py:121), and the classification path log is gone. The reference makes the same change (reference/monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py logs one message per batch).
criteria.deficiency: No deficiency found. The logging reduction is a behavior change from base, shared with the reference, and is covered under requirement_intent.

evidence: Metadata is optional in both savers: csv_saver.py:52-55 keys by index when meta is absent; nifti_saver.py:87-94 handles affine=None, which write_nifti maps to eye(4) (base nifti_writer.py:28-29).

SegmentationSaver dtype is honored (nifti_saver.py:102, passed to write_nifti at :105). Its default of None keeps the data's own dtype, matching the base's effective behavior (base segmentation_saver.py:120).

ClassificationSaver filename is configurable (classification_saver.py:24, :47). The TensorBoard index is honored (tensorboard_handlers.py:200, :224; img2tensorboard.py:154). The 3D single-channel tag keeps the base's '_HW_0' suffix (img2tensorboard.py:170).

Extra robustness beyond the reference, not required: the None-filter in save_batch (csv_saver.py:73; nifti_saver.py:120), the blank-row skip (csv_saver.py:84-85), and the output_dir guard (csv_saver.py:88).

Behavior changes from base, shared with the reference: sorted row order is dropped (base classification_saver.py:72 vs generated csv_saver.py:91), and per-file and classification log lines are removed.
Unverified by execution: tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py keeps epoch_length=2, which the reference removes. The base had the same call, so there is no new regression by reading.
criteria.deficiency: No deficiency found. The sort removal and reduced logging are behavior changes from base. They match the reference, which is the source of truth for intended behavior.
